title: Labeling mode
subtitle: Label the pages of a folder in order to train the question detection model. "Save to bank" also adds the questions to the question bank (no test).
labeledError: Could not load the list of previously labeled pages.
emptyHint: All images in it and its subfolders (webp, jpg, jpeg, png) are added to the pool; pages come in folder and file name order.
noImages: No images found in the selected folder.
allDone: All labeled — no pages left to label in this folder.
skipHint: Go to the next page without training (N)
trainHint: Add the page to the training data with all its questions marked

bank.hint: Save the page's questions with their correct options to the question pool without a test (subject/topic classification is automatic), then send the page for training like Train and go to the next page.
bank.noMcq: There are no multiple-choice questions to save to the pool.
bank.saved: {{count}} questions saved to the pool; classification started in the background.
bank.alreadySaved: This page's questions were already saved to the pool ({{count}} questions). Saving again creates them a second time.
bank.failed: The questions could not be saved to the pool.
bank.forbidden: Only teachers and admins can save questions to the pool.
bank.savedAndTrained: {{count}} questions saved to the pool and sent for training; classification started in the background.

cropDuplicate.title: This crop is already in the bank
cropDuplicate.message: The same question image is in the bank in {{count}} record(s).
cropDuplicate.question: Question #{{id}}
cropDuplicate.hint: Saving anyway creates the question a second time.

answerKey.title: Answer key page
answerKey.message: This page is in the book's answer key range. Save it as questions anyway?

pageLoadFailedHint: This page could not be read and cannot be sent for training. Continue with "Skip / Next".
predictFailedHint: Automatic detection failed. Press "Detect again" or draw the question boxes by hand; an empty canvas is not sent for training.
pageIdMismatch: The sent image did not match the open page; the page was not counted as labeled. Detect the page again and retry.

inspector.title: Question inspector
inspector.answerCountMismatch: Must have {{count}} choices; a mismatched question cannot be sent for training.
inspector.emptyHint: No questions on this page. Draw a question box or re-detect; Train with no questions sends the page as an empty page.

hint.activity: Activities are not sent to training or saved to the bank from this screen; they go to the activity flow.
hint.info_box: Info boxes are not cropped: they are not sent to training or the bank.
hint.answer_key: Answer keys are not cropped: they are not sent to training or the bank.
hint.noise: Noise (optical form, QR code, page header …) is not cropped: it is not sent to training or the bank.

source.label: Source
source.manualHint: The version sent to training (only when saved)
source.askAgainConfirm: Claude will be asked again and billed; the saved result will be overwritten.
source.askAgainConfirmEdits: Claude will be asked again (billed) and your unsaved corrections will be lost.
source.manualIsTraining: This is the version used for training.
source.manualExists: This page has a saved manual labeling; choose Manual to see it.
source.unsavedEdits: You have unsaved corrections; they will be lost if the source changes.
source.aiFailed: Claude could not label this page.
source.promptSaved: Prompt v{{version}} saved; the next Claude calls use it.

prompt.title: Claude prompt settings
prompt.hint: Saving creates a new version; old versions are kept. The coordinate rules and the response format (JSON) are fixed and not edited here. When the prompt changes, pages are sent to Claude again with the new prompt (billed).
prompt.placeholders: {width} and {height}: pixel size of the image sent to Claude
prompt.expandQuestionToOptions: Question box covers all of its choices
prompt.loadFailed: Prompt settings could not be loaded.
prompt.placeholderMissing: Warning: {width} or {height} is missing — without the pixel size Claude's boxes may drift.

activity.loadFailed: Activity instructions could not be loaded.
activity.hint: Crops of activity blocks of this type are sent to Claude with this instruction. Saving creates a new version; only this type's cache is invalidated (drafts of other types come from the cache). The response schema is fixed.
activity.missing: The server returned no instruction for this type.

prompt.unsavedOthers: Other tabs have unsaved changes; they will be lost if you save and close:

hints.answerKey: The book's answer key page is sent to Claude with this instruction; rows (printed page, activity, item, answer, visual or not) are extracted. Saving creates a new version; only the answer key readings' cache is invalidated. The response schema is fixed.
hints.solveFromKey: For items whose answer is a picture, the activity crop and the key crop are sent together with this instruction; the solution follows the activity type's schema. Saving creates a new version; only solutions from the key are invalidated.
hints.solveAi: The crop of an activity that is not in the answer key is sent with this instruction; Claude suggests a solution (needs approval). Saving creates a new version; only AI solutions are invalidated.

book.label: Book
book.noPageNumber: No page number in the file name
book.pageFailed: Book info could not be loaded
book.tocHint: From the table of contents: the subject / topic default when saving to the bank
book.tocGradeMismatch: The grade differs from the table of contents; the book topic will not be applied
book.tocStale: The table of contents entry is invalid (deleted topic)

structure.title: Activity draft
structure.claudeOnly: The draft structure is extracted only for the Claude source (or a manual record that started from Claude).
structure.notApplied: The draft could not be applied to the canvas (empty plan or it does not fit this type).
structure.invalid: The draft failed validation and needs fixing:
structure.reExtractHint: Ignores the saved draft and asks Claude again; this is billed.
structure.reExtractConfirm: Claude will be asked again for this activity's structure and it will be billed. Your manual edits are kept; the new draft replaces them only via "Apply draft".
structure.missingResult: The server returned no result for this block.
structure.failed: The activity structure could not be extracted.
structure.unavailable: Claude is not configured; activity structure cannot be extracted.
structure.promptSaved: {{type}} instruction v{{version}} saved; only drafts of this type use the new instruction. Manually edited activities are kept; the new draft replaces them only via "Apply draft".
structure.promptUnchanged: Instruction unchanged (v{{version}}); nothing to extract again.
structure.kept: Your manual edits were kept; the draft was not applied to the canvas.
structure.applyConfirm: The draft will be applied to the canvas; your manual edits to this activity will be lost.
structure.stale: The box changed; the draft will be extracted again.

answerKey.readHint: Claude reads the rows on this answer key page (printed page, activity, item, answer); a stored result is returned for free.
answerKey.title: Answer key
answerKey.visualHint: The answer is a small picture; its box is drawn dashed on the page and the solution is taken from the key crop.
answerKey.empty: No answer rows were found on this page.
answerKey.rereadHint: Ignores the stored result, asks Claude again and is charged.
answerKey.rereadConfirm: Claude will read this answer key page again and it will be charged; the rows are replaced with the new ones.
answerKey.notRead: This page is in the book's answer key. Use "Read answer key" in the toolbar to extract its rows.
answerKey.claudeOff: Claude is not configured; the answer key cannot be read.
answerKey.failed: The answer key could not be read.
answerKey.unavailable: Claude is not configured; the answer key cannot be read.
answerKey.invalidPage: The printed page must be a whole number between 1 and 100000.
answerKey.saveFailed: The row could not be saved.
answerKey.deleteFailed: The row could not be deleted.
answerKey.stale: The instruction / model changed — the stored rows are shown; reading again is paid.

overwrite.title: Some rows were corrected by hand
overwrite.message: This page has answer key rows corrected by hand; reading again will delete them.

bulk.hint: Select the answer key pages (images) of the selected book; Claude reads them one by one, stored readings are free.
bulk.stale: stored rows kept on {{count}} pages (different instruction / model)
bulk.unreadable: The file could not be read.
bulk.keptEdits: Rows corrected by hand were kept; not read again.

solution.title: Solution
solution.noBook: No book or file page: the answer key cannot be searched, the solution is suggested by AI.
solution.needLabel: Enter the activity label to find it in the answer key (e.g. "Activity 3").
solution.keyFailed: The answer key could not be searched.
solution.keyFound: {{count}} rows found in the answer key.
solution.keyNone: Not in the answer key — manual marking comes with #581; you can ask AI to solve it (paid).
solution.notApplied: The solution could not be applied to the canvas (it does not fit this activity's plan).
solution.kept: Your manual edits on the canvas were kept; the solution was not applied.
solution.applyConfirm: The solution will be applied to the canvas; your manual edits on this activity will be lost.
solution.edited: The solution was changed on the canvas; once saved it needs approval again.
solution.approveHint: Approves the solution; the approver and time are recorded.
solution.approveEditedHint: The correction on the canvas is saved and approved; the source becomes "Manual".
solution.aiHint: Claude suggests a solution for an activity that is not in the answer key; a stored result is returned for free.
solution.resolveHint: Ignores the stored solution, asks Claude again and is charged.
solution.resolveConfirm: Claude will be asked for this activity's solution again and it will be charged; the new solution needs approval.
solution.failed: The solution could not be extracted.
solution.unavailable: Claude is not configured; the solution cannot be extracted.
solution.emptyEdit: There is no solution on the canvas; nothing to save.
solution.forbidden: Only QuestionTrainer and Admin can approve solutions.
solution.approveFailed: The solution could not be approved.
solution.saveFailed: The correction could not be saved.
solution.promptSaved: {{kind}} instruction v{{version}} saved; only this instruction's results are regenerated (paid).
solution.approveInvalidHint: The solution failed validation; correct it on the canvas first.
solution.planChanged: Plan changed, solve again: the solution was not written for the plan on the canvas; approval and saving corrections are disabled.
solution.planChangedStored: Plan changed, solve again: the stored solution was written for a different draft plan.
solution.ambiguous: Several activities with this label are in the answer key; pick which one:

mcqKey.failed: The answer key could not be searched.
mcqKey.notFound: Not found in the answer key; mark the correct option by hand.
mcqKey.ambiguous: The answer key has several rows; pick the right one:
